approach: Add __hash__ and __eq__ methods based on id field for set/dict compatibility
implementation_details: Added __hash__ method returning hash(self.id) for hashability
Added __eq__ method comparing by id for identity semantics
Both methods enable Todo objects to be used in sets and as dict keys
Deduplication works based on id field as specified in acceptance criteria
acceptance_criteria_met: hash(Todo(id=1, text='a')) does not raise TypeError
risks: Changing __eq__ from dataclass default (all fields) to id-only may affect existing code that compares todos by all fields
